dish.title: Crispy Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
dish.name: Crispy Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
dish.description: Cornmeal-crusted pan-fried cod in corn tortillas with a cabbage-carrot slaw and dairy-free crema.

recipe_version.title: Crispy Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
recipe_version.description: Cornmeal-crusted pan-fried cod in corn tortillas with a cabbage-carrot slaw and dairy-free crema.
recipe_version.doneness: Crust golden. Cod opaque, flakes easily, 145 F in the center of a strip. Not chalky.

substitutions.crema: Store-bought dairy-free crema, or 1/2 cup vegan mayo plus the juice of 1/2 lime. Do not use sour cream or yogurt.
substitutions.soy: Some vegan mayos and dairy-free cremas contain soy. Soy is not a confirmed allergen until the brand is known.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for the first fry; up to 1 tbsp more if a second batch looks dry

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: juice of 1 in the slaw; the second lime is wedges, or juice of 1/2 of it in homemade crema and the remaining half as wedges

ingredients.name: dairy-free crema
ingredients.note: store-bought, or whisk 1/2 cup vegan mayo with the juice of 1/2 lime. Either path must be dairy-free.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp in the slaw, 1/2 tsp in the cornmeal. Diamond Crystal. If Morton, use half. v1 told the cook to add salt and never listed it.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: 1/4 tsp in the slaw, 1/4 tsp in the cornmeal. v1 called for pepper and never listed it.

steps.title: Prep the slaw
steps.body: Toss the green cabbage, carrot, cilantro, the juice of 1 lime, 1/2 tsp of the kosher salt, and 1/4 tsp of the black pepper. Rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Coat and crisp the fish
steps.body: Pat the cod dry. Dredge the strips in the cornmeal, smoked paprika, the remaining 1/2 tsp kosher salt, and the remaining 1/4 tsp black pepper. Pan-fry in 2 tbsp neutral oil over medium-high heat, 3-4 minutes per side, until the crust is golden and the center of a strip is opaque, flakes easily, and reaches 145 F. Add up to 1 tbsp more oil if a second batch looks dry. No egg and no wheat flour in the dredge.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.body: Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet 20-30 seconds per side over medium heat.

steps.title: Build the tacos
steps.body: If using store-bought dairy-free crema, cut the second lime into wedges. If making the crema, whisk 1/2 cup vegan mayo with the juice of 1/2 of the second lime and cut the remaining half into wedges. Fill the tortillas with the fish, slaw, and crema. Serve with the lime wedges. Four servings, two tacos each.

projection.allergen_note: Finfish is an allergen, from the cod. It is not a dietary tag. Tacos are a format, not a diet. Dairy-free is the dietary claim. Soy may occur in a chosen crema and is not listed as a confirmed allergen.
